units.source_text: 一旦开始干活，并没有感觉到预想的抵触情绪。

en.t: Once he started working, he did not feel the resistance he had expected.

units.source_text: 这个变化的原因究竟是什么呢？

en.t: What, after all, was the reason for this change?

units.source_text: 难道是害怕断水的关系吗，难道是自觉欠了女人一份情的关系吗，

en.t: Was it because he feared having the water cut off, or because he felt he owed the woman a debt of gratitude,

units.source_text: 抑或是劳动本身的性质所决定的吗？

en.t: or was it determined by the very nature of labor itself?

units.source_text: 的确，劳动是人们在没有前途时，得以忍耐逐渐逃走的时间的依靠。

en.t: Indeed, when people have no future, labor is what lets them endure the time that gradually slips away.
